scope: Full native interpreter versus production on retail pl02.anm scripts 16..19 through scheduled interrupt and termination at rates .5/1/1.25: primary color and  sprite, color, layer, resolution flags, active bit, clock, position, scale and extra scale. Native sprite binding and child creation are controlled; script-16 child requests 17/18 are checked; each child is independently executed with interrupt 1 at frame 180; auxiliary 19 runs through termination. Native geometry allocation is a controlled buffer; geometry vertices and secondary color are outside this proof. Sprite index is compared after a native binder request; script 16 never binds a sprite, so its initial observer sentinel is excluded. No GPU/pixel or full Bomb-controller equivalence is claimed.
